visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a light blue cardigan and white turtleneck, stands against a white background holding a pink eyeshadow palette and lip gloss. She gestures towards the makeup items while looking at the camera. (2) A close-up view shows a person's arm with four horizontal swipes of beige and brown eyeshadow swatches. (3) The woman is shown applying eyeshadow to her eyelid with a small brush in a brightly lit indoor setting. (4) A top-down close-up view of the open nine-square eyeshadow palette featuring matte and shimmery nude tones. (5) The woman points at a specific glittery shade in the palette. (6) A close-up of a hand with a silver ring shows a shimmering swatch on the skin. (7) The woman closes her eyes to display the completed neutral eye makeup look. (8) A hand applies a dark red liquid lip tint swatch onto the back of another hand. (9) The woman applies the red lip tint to her lips with an applicator and then blends it with her finger. (10) She poses holding both products, showing the finished makeup look. (11) A screen capture of a Japanese website with location maps and store information is shown. (12) The woman returns to the screen, holding the palette and gesturing for audience engagement.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with short black hair, red lipstick, red nail polish, wearing a light blue buttoned knit cardigan over a white high-neck top and a silver ring.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A plain, neutrally lit indoor wall; transitions briefly to a screen recording of a Japanese store locator website.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful female voice introduces a Japanese makeup brand over a light, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody. The delivery is clear and enthusiastic. (2) As the speaker describes the eyeshadow palette's price and features, the background music maintains a steady major-key rhythm with light percussive elements. (3) A subtle digital 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the transition between the eye makeup and lip tint reviews. (4) The narrator's tone remains consistent and informative, ending with a direct question to the audience as the music fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Introduction -> Eyeshadow Demo/Swatches -> Lip Tint Demo/Swatches -> Store Info -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a budget-friendly makeup review focusing on the Japanese brand 'Kirei&co.', highlighting its extreme affordability compared to Canmake and demonstrating the application results of an eyeshadow palette and lip tint for a 'clear water' (minimalist) makeup style.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically names the brand 'Kirei&co.', shows its packaging clearly, provides price comparisons, and even shows a screen recording of the brand's store locator, strongly suggesting a promotional intent.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-arousal narration and bright studio lighting typical of beauty influencers to emphasize the product's value-for-money.
